tex_content.html:
Definition
[connected/disconnected at infinity]

Source: petersen:page-0314 A complete manifold $(M,g)$ is connected at infinity if for every compact $K\subset M$ there is a compact $C\supset K$ such that any two points of $M-C$ can be joined by a curve in $M-K$. Otherwise $(M,g)$ is disconnected at infinity.
